lines.statement: 4 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Skye at Holland, 666 new sales, about 1,340 m; Penrith, 457 new sales, about 1,720 m; The Hill @One-North, 14 new sales, about 1,830 m; Blossoms by the Park, 11 new sales, about 1,850 m). Subsales (22) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.
